systems.system: ODPC Guidance Note on the Processing of Biometric Data (draft)
systems.country_label: Draft guidance advising data controllers and processors to follow ISO/IEC 39794-1, -4 and -5; a data protection authority advisory, not adoption by the standards body or a requirement on public bodies
systems.owner: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

note: Draft ODPC guidance advises adherence to ISO/IEC 39794 biometric standards; a draft advisory is neither adoption as a national standard nor a binding requirement on government.
